tools.name: check_obligations
tools.description: Checks, from a few facts about the company, whether it legally needs an EU GDPR Art. 27 representative, a UK GDPR Art. 27 representative and/or a GPSR Art. 16 EU responsible person, explains why with the legal basis and lists exemptions. Recommends the cheapest REP27 combination. Returns result_url,

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Returns REP27 plans with first-year price, renewal price and what each includes, for the GDPR Art. 27 representative (territory eu, uk or both) or the GPSR Art. 16 responsible person. Includes free-trial and cancellation terms.

tools.name: find_product_category
tools.description: Searches REP27's product-category catalogue (toys, cosmetics, electronics, pet products, connected devices…) and returns, for the best matches, the EU legal figure required (responsible person, authorised representative, Art. 4 economic operator, GDPR representative) and the REP27 service.

tools.name: about_rep27
tools.description: Who provides the REP27 service, legal entities, contacts, terms and verification.

tools.name: start_free_trial
tools.description: Starts the REP27 7-day free trial (no card) for the given contact name, work email, company and country. The user receives an email to continue.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Creates the secure Mollie checkout for the chosen REP27 plan with the buyer's company, country, contact name and email, and returns the payment link. Payment happens on Mollie's page, never in the chat.
